words: What is the body part at the end of one leg called?
It has toes and goes inside a shoe.
What do we call the body parts at the ends of your legs?
This is the word for more than one foot.
The robot finds just one body part with toes. What has it found?
Count one, then choose the name of the body part that has toes.
The robot finds both body parts with toes, one for each leg. What has it found?
Count two, then choose the name of the body parts that have toes.
Your head, arms, hands and feet are all examples of what?
They are different parts of your body.
